outcome_detail: This high-pressure time-limited environment run (creative team) reached 100% completion in 14 steps. Stress reached moderate levels with little to no conflict. Agents exchanged 4 pieces of information. Outcome: Completed through creative coordination. This matches the Creative Team preset: agents used flexible idea-sharing, confirmation, and collaborative problem-solving rather than conflict.
